max_seq_len.description: Rows above it are over length; 0 = no limit.

over_length.description: count, drop or refuse; never truncate.

base_model.description: The base model, whose tokenizer is used.

measure.description: response: the answer's tokens (as 1.0.0). example: prompt + response, what a training sequence holds (the chat template aside); max_seq_len then applies to it.
